export_metadata.seller_company: Sentura Demo Mobile Accessories Co., Ltd.

messages.text: Hello, we distribute mobile phone repair parts in Chile. We need tempered glass screen protectors for iPhone 15 and Samsung S24. What is your MOQ and FOB Shenzhen price?
MOQ is 2,000 pcs per model. FOB Shenzhen price is USD 0.38 per piece for iPhone 15 and USD 0.42 per piece for Samsung S24.
If we order 10,000 pcs mixed models, can you do USD 0.35? We need retail packaging with our brand.
For 10,000 pcs, best price is USD 0.36 per piece. Custom retail packaging adds USD 0.03 per piece and 7 days lead time.
Please send PI for 10,000 pcs at USD 0.36 plus USD 0.03 packaging. Payment by T/T 30% deposit, balance before shipment is acceptable.
We are looking for 65W GaN chargers with EU plug, CE and RoHS certificates. Initial quantity 500 pcs for testing.
For 65W GaN charger EU plug, MOQ is 1,000 pcs. EXW price USD 6.80 per piece. CE/RoHS certificates available.
Can we start with 500 pcs at USD 6.50? We need delivery to Hamburg warehouse.
We operate online stores for phone cases and MagSafe accessories. Need clear MagSafe cases for iPhone 16 series, 20,000 pcs monthly if quality is stable.
For clear MagSafe cases, MOQ is 3,000 pcs per model. FOB Shenzhen price starts at USD 1.18 per piece for 5,000 pcs and USD 1.05 for 20,000 pcs.
Please quote 5,000 pcs iPhone 16, 5,000 pcs iPhone 16 Pro, 5,000 pcs iPhone 16 Pro Max. We need Amazon FBA barcode stickers and drop-test packaging.
Total 15,000 pcs can be USD 1.10 per piece. FBA barcode sticker is USD 0.015 per piece. Drop-test packaging is USD 0.08 per piece.
